D/ CONSTANTINVS[--] ; R/ GLOR IAEXER CITVS

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, probably of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, possibly London mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust possibly laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IAEXER CITVS. In exergue: U [enclosing dot] PLN. Diameter: 17.3mm,…
